title: Design System: Easy Quote evaluation workspace

title.purpose: Compact evaluator h1, not a display face.

section.purpose: Execution steps and nested report sections.

body.purpose: System UI text throughout the evaluator.

hint.purpose: Field hints, session metadata and explanatory copy.

status.purpose: Compact text-labelled execution and automated states.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Immediate active-button feedback; disabled buttons and prefers-reduced-motion suppress it. No timed transition.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled Start or Save action; this preview has no execution handler.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.25rem; min-width:0; max-width:100%; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-accent,#245bb5); border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--color-accent,#245bb5); color:var(--color-on-accent,#ffffff); font:600 14px/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-primary:hover { filter:brightness(.93); } .ds-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#245bb5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { color:var(--color-muted,#566273); background:var(--color-hover,#e9edf3); border-color:var(--color-rule,#d4dae3); cursor:not-allowed; filter:none; transform:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Neutral Stop action; this preview has no execution handler.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.25rem; min-width:0; max-width:100%; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule,#d4dae3); border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--color-paper,#ffffff); color:var(--color-ink,#202733); font:600 14px/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-hover,#e9edf3); } .ds-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#245bb5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { color:var(--color-muted,#566273); background:var(--color-hover,#e9edf3); border-color:var(--color-rule,#d4dae3); cursor:not-allowed; transform:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-secondary:active { transform:none; } }

components.description: Small secondary button used for Select visible and Clear.

components.name: Theme control
components.description: Transparent masthead control names the destination theme; preview shows styling only.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark theme">Dark mode</button>
components.css: .ds-theme { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.25rem; min-width:0; max-width:100%; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule,#d4dae3); border-radius:.25rem; background:transparent; color:var(--color-muted,#566273); font:600 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-theme:hover { background:transparent; filter:none; } .ds-theme:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#245bb5); outline-offset:3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-theme:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Labelled search field
components.description: Persistent label and muted placeholder for scenario search.

components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.375rem; color:var(--color-ink,#202733); font:550 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); } .ds-search { min-width:0; max-width:100%; padding:.5rem .625rem; border:1px solid var(--color-control,#8c98a8); border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--color-paper,#ffffff); color:var(--color-ink,#202733); caret-color:var(--color-accent,#245bb5); font:400 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); } .ds-search::placeholder { color:var(--color-muted,#566273); opacity:1; font-weight:400; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#245bb5); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-search:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Text-labelled statuses
components.description: Neutral execution status and separate failed or passed automated outcomes.
components.html: Execution: completed Automated: failed Automated: passed
components.css: .ds-statuses { color:var(--color-ink,#202733); font:14px/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); } .ds-status { display:inline-block; border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--color-hover,#e9edf3); padding:.125rem .5rem; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-status.ds-failed { color:var(--color-error,#ad2c36); background:var(--color-error-bg,#fff1f2); } .ds-status.ds-passed { color:var(--color-success,#236b46); background:var(--color-success-bg,#eaf6ef); }

components.css: .ds-session { border:1px solid var(--color-rule,#d4dae3); border-radius:.375rem; padding:.875rem 1.25rem; background:var(--color-paper,#ffffff); color:var(--color-ink,#202733); margin:.75rem 0; font:14px/1.5 var(--font-body,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif); } .ds-session-summary { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); align-items:baseline; gap:1rem; } .ds-session-summary h2 { margin:0; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.25; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-session p { overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-session-summary p { margin:0; font-size:.8125rem; } .ds-session-summary > p:last-child { text-align:right; } .ds-session-meta { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:.5rem 1.25rem; margin:.375rem 0; color:var(--color-muted,#566273); font-size:.8125rem; } .ds-session-toolbar { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.625rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:.5rem 0; font-size:.8125rem; } .ds-session a { color:var(--color-accent,#245bb5); text-underline-offset:.2em; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-session a:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-session details { margin:0; } .ds-session summary { padding:.375rem 0; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-session summary:hover { color:var(--color-accent,#245bb5); } .ds-session :focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#245bb5); outline-offset:3px; } @media (max-width:1100px) { .ds-session-summary { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; } .ds-session-summary > :nth-child(2) { grid-column:1; } .ds-session-summary > :last-child { grid-column:2; grid-row:1 / 3; max-width:20rem; } } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-session { padding-inline:1rem; } .ds-session-summary { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:start; gap:.25rem; } .ds-session-summary > :last-child { text-align:left; max-width:none; } }

narrative.overview:
This system applies only to the standalone local evaluator under `eval/`, launched with `npm run eval:start`. It does not define or replace the customer-facing Easy Quote application's design. Preserve the product app outside `eval/`.

Neutral divided panes, compact labelled controls and a blue action accent support scenario selection and failure inspection. Light and dark themes retain the same hierarchy. Evidence stays available through disclosures and links rather than a permanent reference sidebar.
keyCharacteristics: Compact system typography and bordered work panes.
Semantic outcomes with explicit text labels.
Light and dark themes with matching structure.
dos: Do apply these tokens only to the standalone evaluator under `eval/`.
Do keep execution status, automated outcomes and human review separately labelled.
Do preserve mobile table captions, accessible headers and visible Expected/Actual labels.
Do retain keyboard focus feedback and evidence disclosure links in both themes.
donts: Don't restyle the customer-facing application from this evaluator document.
Don't imply a completed session passed its automated checks or human review.
Don't describe ended execution as still running.
Don't introduce decorative raster assets, web fonts or shadows into this documented workspace.
